{{recipe}}

'''Jerk lobster''' is a dish made popular by Nathanyay Chang. 

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:lobster|lobster]] tails
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Jamaican Jerk Spice|jerk seasoning]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 whole [[Cookbook:Green onion|scallions]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]] or [[Cookbook:Lime|lime juice]]
* ½ tsp Jamaican pickapeppa sauce or 3 drops of Jamaican hot pepper sauce (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] the scallions.
# Melt the butter in a small [[Cookbook:skillet|skillet]].
# Lightly [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] the scallions until golden.
# Add the lemon juice.
# Add Jamaica pickapeppa sauce or hot pepper sauce (optional, depending on your taste).
# Let it [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 1 minute, then set aside.
# Remove the membrane from the lobster tails.
# Use a sharp knife to split the lobster tail in half lengthwise.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] butter sauce onto each tail.
# Using the same brush, spread the jerk sauce over the tails, especially on the exposed meat. Set oven to [[Cookbook:Broiler|broil]].
# Put the lobster tails in oven on the meat side for 4 minutes, turn, and cook the shell side for 2 minutes.
# If you want a more smoked taste, cook for 2 minutes on each side in the oven, then place on a barbecue [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] for 3 minutes. You may need to add more jerk sauce if using a grill.
# Serve with Jamaican festival and/or bammy. You can also serve with Jamaican hardo bread.
